operations.operation: Separate resident history archives from selected configuration and manifest inputs
operations.additional_object_publication: None. Canonical filesystem-name validation before configuration, actor, precheck and numerical recipe reads.
operations.notes: Resolve at most two selected archive paths against the bounded command inputs, manifest path and up to three input paths for each of at most sixteen entries. Each check uses filesystem path-resolution metadata and a temporary set of at most two canonical archive names; it reads no archive payload, model or journal and appends no event. Existing archive admission, semantic replay and final export retain their own costs. Filesystem latency remains unmeasured; these checks do not establish hostile-filesystem isolation.

operations.notes: The independently selected capsule is read once under CredibilityActivation::MAX_ENCODED_BYTES after the original anchored recovery Fence and before new numerical work. The original reducer validates the complete committee and held-out joint requirements and advances the authority epoch once. Recovery replay/Fence, source refresh, subsequent generation, review, publication and archive retention retain their separate original costs. Stop/deadline checks surround activation. Later releases do not reread the capsule; policy promotion invalidates previous-policy qualification and cannot obtain free requalification. No latency or execution measurement is claimed.

operations.notes: The selected complete stimulus roster runs under the original scalar-product allowance, check capacity, source, Stop and deadline constraints. Actor-stream preparation counters do not measure total identity inference or historical replay. Observer custody and completed/interrupted work remain with the original session through capture or cleanup; no new durable partial-token escrow is claimed. Recovery withdraws matching eligibility and requires independently selected fresh evidence without refunding work. No measured latency, empirical detector quality or runtime qualification is claimed.

logical_to_physical_rule: Each storage profile must explicitly map logical commits to fsync/directory/replication barriers. Group commit amortizes physical work but does not erase causal order.
